decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 15th October 2004 the proposed roof extension at 5 Rosslyn Gardens, Feltham would not be lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The development does not fall within Class B Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because part of the roof extension would extend beyond the plane of the northern roof slope which fronts Rosslyn Avenue.  Furthermore, the cubic content of the resulting roof extension and all applicable extensions would exceed the maximum permitted development volume of 70 cubic metres for development to a semi-detached dwelling.

A planning application for the proposed development would therefore be required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for hip to gable loft conversion to dwellinghouse
